title: Federal approval.
bodyText: The department shall seek waivers and any additional approvals from the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services that may be necessary to implement the hospital sustainability program, including approval of the contracts between the State and medicaid managed care health plans.
bodyHtml: §346G-7  Federal approval.  The department shall seek waivers and any additional approvals from the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services that may be necessary to implement the hospital sustainability program, including approval of the contracts between the State and medicaid managed care health plans. [L 2012, c 217, pt of §2, §5; am L 2013, c 141, pt of §1, §2; am L 2014, c 123, §2; am L 2015, c 70, §2; am L 2016, c 60, §3; am L 2017, c 59, §5; am L 2019, c 173, §6; am L 2021, c 38, §7; am L 2023, c 110, §§7, 11]
